canonical_project: Nouakchott Data Hub / Nouakchott national data centre
owner: Société pour le Développement des Infrastructures Numériques (SDIN) / Government of Mauritania; operated by International Mauritania Telecom (IMT)
notes: EIB reported the Nouakchott data centre was inaugurated on 8 May 2025, backed by a EUR 15m EIB loan for a Tier III data centre. SDIN identifies the Datacenter and national backbone/IXP as transferred WARCIP assets, and Uptime lists Nouakchott Data Hub in Nouakchott for SDIN. Assigned to West Nouakchott because local press and institutional addresses place the site/SDIN activity in Tevragh-Zeina/Nouakchott Ouest. Public MW not found; sources describe about 100 server racks and Tier III certification.
